name:
The Westin Playa Vallarta, an All-Inclusive Resort
Accepting Bookings starting May 2026

address.street: Av. Paseo de la Marina Sur # 205

insider_take: Brand new luxury awaits in Puerto Vallarta's golden coastline - where Westin's wellness philosophy meets Mexico's vibrant beach culture in an all-inclusive paradise opening May 2026.
whats_special: This marks Westin's exciting return to the all-inclusive resort space in one of Mexico's most beloved beach destinations. Located along Puerto Vallarta's stunning Pacific coastline, guests will experience the brand's signature wellness amenities including the heavenly Westin bed, refreshing white tea products, and innovative healthy dining options - all within a comprehensive all-inclusive package.
pro_tip: Book early for this highly anticipated opening! As Puerto Vallarta's newest luxury all-inclusive under the prestigious Marriott Luminous Program, availability will be limited especially during peak winter months when the destination's perfect 80°F weather attracts travelers escaping colder climates.
dont_miss: The resort's prime location offers easy access to Puerto Vallarta's famous Malecón boardwalk, vibrant downtown art scene, and the iconic Los Arcos rock formations. Take advantage of being steps away from championship golf courses and world-class sport fishing, while enjoying the convenience of an all-inclusive experience at Mexico's newest Westin property.
pros: Premium Westin brand experience with signature wellness amenities
All-inclusive luxury resort in beautiful Puerto Vallarta
Part of Marriott Luminous Program with exclusive benefits
Brand new property with modern facilities and design
cons: New property with bookings starting May 2026
Limited availability for immediate travel plans
